label: Focused follow-up and administrative services
instruction: INITIAL GENERATION of the next compact ELM service component. Use actual model fields and existing service functions supplied below. Generate only services/actions.py, at most approximately 180 source lines, with MODULE-LEVEL functions for cancellation, extension, resumption, substitute response, administrative configuration/offline record actions, year-end, and SLA handling. Keep each operation compact and use action dispatch where useful. Do not redefine models, copy reference files, create per-field accessors, repeat process_* methods, or write placeholder pass functions. These are initial implementation attempts from the original problem statement, not a functional correctness review. Reuse Fusion Principal and exact leave_elm permission literals in registry.py. Use core.api.exceptions errors and Django ORM. Make public function signatures clear so the next API generation can call them. Do not modify the existing core service or model definitions. Return one complete JSON file and stop.
